blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Preference optimization (PO) is the standard way to reduce object hallucination in large vision-language models. We find that four public PO checkpoints of LLaVA-1.5-7B also lower object coverage. They name fewer object categories, and their lower hallucination rates bring no significant gain in set-level object F1 on CHAIR. We therefore ask how much of the PO gain the base model can reproduce by stopping earlier. A positive end-of-sequence (EOS) logit bias lets the base model reach the recall of each PO model, and this early stopping alone reproduces 58 to 86 percent of the CHAIRi gain of three checkpoints on two disjoint COCO sets. Writing longer does not bring the lost categories back. Under greedy decoding, a negative EOS bias recovers only 2 to 9 percent of the lost CHAIR recall of these checkpoints, and 94 to 96 percent of the added object mentions repeat categories already named. On CHAIR, the base caption of the same image still names about half of the missed object categories. We therefore propose base-guided object-category restoration, which appends high-confidence base-only categories to the PO caption without training. With thresholds fixed on a development set, it brings three checkpoints within one point of the base recall on a held-out COCO set with a lower distinct-object hallucination rate than the base model. Against the recall-matched base stopping curve, its gain holds for RLAIF-V near the base recall and for RLAIF-V and CHAIR-DPO at an intermediate recall. We will release the code of the recall-controlled evaluation.
blocks.zh: 偏好优化(PO)是在大型视觉语言模型中减少对象幻觉的标准方法. 我们认为,LLaVA-1.5-7B的四个公共PO检查站也降低了物体的覆盖范围。 它们命名对象类别较少,而其较低的幻觉率在CHAIR上的设定级对象F1没有显著收益. 因此,我们询问PO有多少通过更早的停止而获得了基础模型的复制. 一个积极的末端记录(EOS)的偏差让基本模式达到了每个PO模式的召回,而这个早期的停止单是重复了两个不相连的COCO集上三个检查站的58%至86%的CHAIRi收益. 写得更长不会使丢失的类别恢复. 在贪婪的解码下,负面的EOS偏好只恢复了这些检查站失落的CHAIR召回量的2%至9%,94%至96%的新增对象提到已经命名的重复类别. 在CHAIR上,同一图像的底标题仍然取出大约一半被忽略对象类别的名称. 因此,我们提议恢复基准指导对象类别,在不经过培训的情况下,将高度信任基础类别附加到PO标题中。 由于在一组发展装置上设定了阈值,因此在基地召回点的一分之内,将三个检查站放在一个被搁置的COCO上,其明显物体幻觉率低于基准模型。 与回扣相匹配的基站曲线相比,其在基站回扣附近的RLAIF-V以及中间回扣上的RLAIF-V和CHAIR-DPO的收益。 我们将发布召回控制评估的代码。

blocks.en:
Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often mention objects that are not in the image.
This object hallucination is measured on captions with CHAIR [ 16 ] and AMBER [ 18 ] , and on yes/no questions with POPE [ 10 ] .
Preference optimization (PO) is now the standard way to reduce it.
Recent methods train with human or AI feedback [ 23 , 24 ] , with synthetic dispreferred responses [ 27 , 26 ] , with self-rewarding [ 28 ] or with a CHAIR-based reward [ 2 ] .
They differ mainly in how they build the preference data and share objectives in the style of direct preference optimization (DPO) [ 15 ] .
These methods and training-free decoding methods such as VCD [ 8 ] and GACD [ 19 ] report their gains on the same metrics.
blocks.zh:
大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)经常提及图像中没有的对象.
这个物体的幻觉是用CHAIR [16] 和AMBER [18] 的字幕,以及用POPE [10] 的"是/否"的问题来衡量的.
优惠优化(PO)现在是减少优惠的标准方式.
最近的方法用人或AI的反馈[23,24]来训练,用合成的不受欢迎的反应[27,26],用自我奖励[28]或基于主席的奖励[2].
它们主要在如何构建偏好数据以及以直接偏好优化(DPO)[15]的风格分享目标方面有所不同.
这些方法和无培训的解码方法,如VCD[8]和GACD[19],都以相同的度量衡报告其收益.

blocks.en:
A hallucination rate counts the wrong objects among the mentioned objects.
A model that mentions fewer objects can therefore lower this rate without seeing the image better.
Fazli et al . [ 4 ] report that the gains of recent inference-time mitigation methods come together with less informative outputs, and Sandhu et al . [ 17 ] find shorter captions with lower object recall after an attention-head intervention on LLaVA.
Longer descriptions also contain more hallucinated objects, so LeHaCE [ 20 ] compares LVLMs at the same description length, as length-controlled evaluation does in LLM alignment [ 3 ] .
Yue et al . [ 25 ] show that a model trained to stop earlier hallucinates less.
These works leave two questions open for trained PO checkpoints. How much of their hallucination gain can a base model reproduce by stopping earlier? Does their lost recall come back when they write longer?
blocks.zh:
幻觉率将错误的物体计算在内物体中.
因此,提到较少对象的模型可以降低这个速率,而不会更好地看到图像.
Fazli等人[4] 报告说,最近推论时间缓解方法的收获与信息较少的产出结合在一起,Sandhu等人[17] 在LLAVA的注意力点干预后,找到了较短的标题,对象召回率较低。
更长的描述中也包含更多的幻觉对象,因此LeHACE [20] 以相同的描述长度比较LVLMs,就像长度控制的评价在LLM对齐[3]中所做的那样.
Yue et al. [25] 显示训练有素的模型可以阻止早期的幻觉较少.
这些工作给训练有素的PO检查站留下了两个问题。 他们的幻觉增益有多少 通过更早的停止,一个基础模型可以复制? 当他们写得更长的时候,他们的失忆是否又回来了?

blocks.en:
We study four public PO checkpoints of LLaVA-1.5-7B [ 12 ] , namely RLAIF-V, CHAIR-DPO, CSR and HA-DPO.
All four lower CHAIRi and object recall together, and the recall drops from 80.5 to between 65.1 and 76.2 on CHAIR-500 ( Tab. 1 ).
They say less in the sense that they name fewer object categories, while their captions stay long.
For such models the usual summaries disagree.
The distinct-object hallucination rate favors every PO model with an interval that excludes zero. In contrast, the set-level object F1 on CHAIR detects no significant gain for any of them, and it drops for CSR on a held-out COCO set.
We then let the base model stop earlier with a single positive end-of-sequence (EOS) logit bias until it reaches the recall of each PO model.
On two disjoint sets of 500 COCO images, this base stopping curve reproduces 58 to 86 percent of the CHAIRi gain of RLAIF-V, CHAIR-DPO and CSR without any training ( Figs. 1 and 2 ).
Matching the caption length with the same EOS bias reproduces only 0 to 24 percent. At equal recall the PO captions are 1.3 to 1.8 times longer than the captions on the curve, so a length-controlled comparison misses this effect.
blocks.zh:
我们研究了LLAVA-1.5-7B的4个公共检查站,即RAIF-V、CHAIR-DPO、CSR和HA-DPO。
所有四个下层的CHAIRi和对象召回加在一起,召回在CHAIR-500上从80.5降至65.1至76.2(图1 ).
它们说得更少,因为它们命名的对象类别较少,而其标题则停留很长.
对于这些模型,通常的概要是不同的。
明显对象幻觉率有利于每个PO模型,间隔排除0. 相比之下,CHAIR上的设定级对象F1检测到它们中任何一个都没有显著收益,它在被搁置的COCO集上降低CSR.
然后,我们让基础模型提前以单一的正序端(EOS)登录偏差停止,直到它达到每个PO模型的召回.
在两组500张COCO图像的断开中,这种基态曲线复制了RAIF-V、CHAIR-DPO和CSR58%至86%的CHARI收益,没有经过任何培训(图1和图2)。
将标题长度与同样的 EOS 偏差相匹配只复制了 0 到 24% 。 同样地,PO标题比曲线上的标题长1.3到1.8倍,所以长控比较错过了这个效果.

blocks.en:
Next, we make RLAIF-V, CHAIR-DPO and CSR write longer with a negative EOS bias of up to 10, to see whether they get their recall back.
While less than 5 percent of the captions reach the length limit, they recover only 2 to 9 percent of the lost CHAIR recall.
Of the object mentions added in this way, 94 to 96 percent refer to object categories that the caption already names ( Tab. 3 ).
Earlier stopping of the base model thus reproduces much of the PO gain, while extending the PO captions recovers little of their lost object recall ( Fig. 2 ). The base caption of the same image still names about half of the COCO categories that these models miss on CHAIR.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们让RLAIF-V,CHAIR-DPO和CSR写得更长,负面的EOS偏差高达10,看看他们是否恢复记忆.
虽然不到5%的字幕达到了长度限制,但是它们只收回失去的主席召回的2%至9%。
在以这种方式添加的对象中,94%至96%指的是标题已经命名的对象类别(Tab.3)。
因此,基础模型的较早停止复制了大部分PO收益,而扩展PO标题则很少恢复其丢失的对象召回(图2)。 同一图像的基本标题仍然列出了这些模型在CHAIR上错过的大约一半COCO类别。

blocks.en:
We turn these observations into an evaluation and a simple intervention.
For the evaluation, we compare a PO model with the stopping curve of its base model at equal recall.
Under greedy decoding, one pass of the base model gives this curve for every nonnegative bias.
At equal recall, RLAIF-V keeps 4.3 to 5.0 CHAIRi points over the two COCO sets, CHAIR-DPO keeps 2.4 to 4.6 points and CSR keeps 1.3 to 2.5 points, while HA-DPO keeps no measurable gain.
blocks.zh:
我们把这些意见变成一种评价和一种简单的干预。
就评价而言,我们比较一个PO模型与其基准模型的停止曲线,以等速召回.
在贪婪的解码下,一个基础模型的通过给每个非负偏差都提供了这个曲线.
同样地,RAIF-V在两套COCO中保持4.3至5.0CHAIRi的积分,CHAIR-DPO保持2.4至4.6的积分,CSR保持1.3至2.5的积分,而HA-DPO则没有保持可衡量的收益.

blocks.en:
For the intervention, we append to the PO caption the object categories that only the base caption names and that the base model generates with high confidence.
The confidence threshold of this base-guided object-category restoration is set on a development set to reach the base recall and is applied unchanged to a held-out set.
There, restoration brings RLAIF-V, CHAIR-DPO and CSR within one point of the base recall, and their distinct-object hallucination rate is 5.2, 1.9 and 1.1 points below the base model ( Tab. 4 ).
This rate is above that of the original PO captions, so restoration keeps only part of the PO gain while it recovers most of the lost recall.
At matched recall, restoration is also below the base stopping curve for RLAIF-V near the base recall and for RLAIF-V and CHAIR-DPO at an intermediate recall, and we find no such advantage over this curve for CSR.
Its hallucination rate is lower than that of random selection of base-only categories.
blocks.zh:
对于发言,我们附加在PO标题中的对象类别中,这些类别只包含基本标题名称,而基础模型以高度的自信生成.
这一基准制对象类别恢复的信心阈值设定在达到基准召回的一组开发物上,对被搁置的一组开发物适用不变。
在那里,恢复将RLAIF-V,CHAIR-DPO和CSR带入基质召回点的一分之内,它们的明显对象幻觉率低于基质模型的5.2,1.9和1.1分(Tab. 4).
这个速率高于原PO标题,因此恢复只保留部分PO收益,同时恢复大部分丢失的召回.
在相应召回时,RLAIF-V在基座召回地点附近的恢复也低于基座停止曲线,而在中间召回地点的RLAIF-V和CHAIR-DPO也低于基座停止曲线,我们发现对于CSR来说,在这个曲线上没有这样的优势.
其幻觉率低于随机选择仅基类.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • We propose recall-controlled evaluation, which compares a PO model with the EOS stopping curve of its base model at equal recall. With it, base stopping reproduces most of the CHAIRi gain of three public PO checkpoints. • We show that, under greedy decoding, the PO captions lose object categories that a later stop does not bring back, while the base caption of the same image still names about half of them on CHAIR. • We propose base-guided object-category restoration, a training-free fusion of the PO and base captions. With the threshold and the acceptance criterion fixed in advance, it brings three PO models within one point of the base recall on a held-out COCO set with a lower hallucination rate than the base model, and we report where it also beats the recall-matched base stopping curve.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下。 我们建议采用召回控制评价,将PO模型与EOS在同等召回时其基础模型的停止曲线进行比较. - 基地停止复制三个公共检查站的CHAIRI收益。 我们显示,在贪婪的解码下, PO 标题会失去一个后站不会带回的对象类别,而同一图像的基标题仍然在CHAIR上命名大约一半. • 支助 我们提议进行基础制导对象类修复,对PO和基础标题进行无训练组合。 随着阈值和接受标准预先固定,它使三个PO模型在基点召回的某一点内,在一个被搁置的COCO集上,其幻觉率比基点模型低,我们报告它还击败了比对基点停止曲线的地方.

With the threshold and the acceptance criterion fixed in advance, it brings three PO models within one point of the base recall on a held-out COCO set with a lower hallucination rate than the base model, and we report where it also beats the recall-matched base stopping curve.

blocks.en:
A hallucination rate can drop because a model mentions fewer objects. We therefore compare a PO model with its base model at the same object recall.
Our evaluation takes a base model, a PO model and a caption benchmark, and it returns the raw and stopping-controlled gains with 95 percent intervals.
A positive bias on the EOS logit makes the base model stop earlier until it reaches the recall of the PO model ( Fig. 2 a).
For the diagnosis in Sec. 5 , a negative bias on the EOS logit of the PO model tests whether the PO model returns to the recall of the base model ( Fig. 2 b).

对EOS logit的正面偏差使得基础模型更早停止,直到达到PO模型的召回(图2 a).

A simple way to change how long a model writes is to add a constant to the EOS logit at every decoding step.
With greedy decoding the effect of this constant can be computed exactly after generation.
Take a caption generated with bias b 0 b_{0} , and let ℓ t ​ ( v ) \ell_{t}(v) be the log-probability of token v v at step t t of this caption under the unbiased model.
Let m t = max v ≠ EOS ⁡ ℓ t ​ ( v ) m_{t}=\max_{v\neq\mathrm{EOS}}\ell_{t}(v) .
For any b ≥ b 0 b\geq b_{0} , the greedy output with bias b b equals the b 0 b_{0} output cut at the first step t t with ℓ t ​ ( EOS ) + b ≥ m t \ell_{t}(\mathrm{EOS})+b\geq m_{t} and closed with EOS.
Before this step the two outputs have the same prefix and therefore the same logits.
One generation with b 0 = 0 b_{0}=0 thus gives every b ≥ 0 b\geq 0 , and one generation with b 0 = − 10 b_{0}=-10 gives every b ≥ − 10 b\geq-10 .
A whole stopping curve costs one decoding pass.
This one-pass identity holds for greedy decoding. The equal-recall comparison can be extended to other decoding methods, but their stopping curves need separate decoding runs.

blocks.en: 2.3 Cross-fitted recall matching

blocks.en:
A bias chosen on the evaluation images also fits the noise of those images.
We therefore split the images at random into two halves.
On one half we choose the bias whose recall is closest to the target recall, and on the other half we compare the models with this bias.
We repeat this for five random splits and both directions of each split, and we sum the counts of all ten evaluation halves before computing the rates.
The evaluation (base to PO recall), the diagnosis (PO to base recall) and the restoration threshold on the development set use the same procedure.
On the evaluation halves, the recall gap between the matched base model and the PO model is between − 0.55 -0.55 and + 0.18 +0.18 points on CHAIR and between − 0.01 -0.01 and + 0.04 +0.04 points on AMBER.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en:
The base model is LLaVA-1.5-7B [ 12 ] , and we study four public PO checkpoints of this model.
RLAIF-V [ 24 ] learns from open-source AI feedback, CHAIR-DPO [ 2 ] from a CHAIR-based reward, CSR [ 28 ] from self-rewarding with CLIP-based calibration, and HA-DPO [ 26 ] from dispreferred responses with inserted hallucinations.
POVID [ 27 ] passed our validation, but in our protocol it does not lower recall and gains only 0.72 CHAIRi points, so it is outside the condition we study ( Appendix D ).
OPA-DPO [ 22 ] trains LoRA weights in the vision tower, which our validated implementation does not cover. The TPO checkpoint released with an earlier version of [ 6 ] was not validated with our implementation, so we leave both models out.
blocks.zh:
基本型号为LLaVA-1.5-7B[12],我们研究这个型号的四个公共PO检查站.
RLAIF-V [24] 从开源AI反馈中吸取教训,CHAIR-DPO [2] 从基于CHAIR的奖励中吸取教训,CSR [28] 从基于CLIP的校准中吸取教训,HA-DPO [26] 从插入幻觉的疏导反应中吸取教训.
POVID[27]通过了我们的验证,但在我们的协议中,它并没有降低召回和只获得0.72 CHAIRI分,因此它超出了我们研究的条件(附录D).
OPA-DPO[22]在视觉塔内列车LORA重量,我们经验证后执行范围不涵盖. 先前发布的TPO检查站[6]版本没有经过我们的执行验证,因此我们不考虑这两个模型。

blocks.en:
We ran all models in the HuggingFace LLaVA implementation.
The converted language model and projector weights were bit-identical to an independent reconstruction at fp16.
Against the original LLaVA code, the base model, CHAIR-DPO, CSR and HA-DPO had a token log-probability difference of at most 0.066 and gave identical greedy captions for 14 to 16 of 16 images.
RLAIF-V had a difference of 0.25, above our threshold of 0.1, so we also decoded CHAIR-500 for RLAIF-V with the original code (head c121f04).
The two implementations gave identical captions for 23 of 32 images, and the nine divergences were near ties with a log-probability margin below 0.1.
The aggregate results hardly changed. With the original code, CHAIRi changed by 0.02, recall by 0.48 and the stopping-controlled gain by 0.10 points, and the gain kept an interval of [2.45, 5.76].
The rest of the paper uses the HuggingFace numbers, and Appendix A gives all parity tests, checkpoint revisions and library versions.

对照最初的LLaVA代码,基模,CHAIR-DPO,CSR和HA-DPO的标志性日志概率差异最多为0.066,并为16幅图像中的14至16幅给出了相同的贪婪字幕.
RLAIF-V的差值为0.25,高于我们0.1的阈值,因此我们也用原始代码(标题c121f04)解码了RAIF-V的CHAIR-500.
这两项执行为32幅图像中的23幅提供了相同的标题,这9幅差异与0.1以下的日志概率差差值密切相关。
总结果几乎没有变化。 随着原始代码的改变,CHAIRi以0.02,召回0.48和停止控制收益0.10分,收益保持了[2.45,5.76]的间隔.
其余的论文使用HuggingFace数字,附录A给出所有对等测试,检查站修订和库版.

blocks.en:
CHAIR-500 uses 500 random images of COCO val2014 [ 11 ] drawn with seed 0.

We also drew a held-out set of 500 other COCO val2014 images with seed 1 and with no overlap with CHAIR-500.
We used it only to validate restoration with fixed thresholds and to replicate the decomposition, and we decoded the base model and the four PO models on it at batch size 16.

blocks.en:
Table 2 compares each PO model with the base stopping curve at its recall.
For RLAIF-V, CHAIR-DPO and CSR, the stopping share is 61, 77 and 86 percent on CHAIR and 20, 64 and 103 percent on AMBER, and all six intervals of s s exclude zero.

The development interval of CSR, [ − 0.03 -0.03 , 2.75], becomes [0.16, 2.82] with a base run at batch size 16 ( Appendix J ).

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Hallucination gains of PO models should be reported together with recall or Cover and with the stopping-controlled gain.
When a model lowers hallucination and recall together, CHAIRi and the set-level F1 can point in different directions, as for CSR on the held-out set.
At equal recall, the hallucination rate of the PO model is compared with that of the base EOS-bias policy, without an exchange rate between the two metrics.
POPE accuracy should be reported with the yes ratio.
blocks.zh:
应将PO模型的幻觉收益与召回或封面和停止控制收益一起报告。
当一个模型降低幻觉并一起召回时,CHAIRi和设定的F1可以指向不同的方向,如同CSR在被搁置的设定上一样.
在同等回想时,将PO模型的幻觉率与基础EOS-bias政策的幻觉率进行比较,没有两个度量衡之间的汇率.
持久性有机污染物的准确性应按 " 是 " 比率报告。

blocks.en: For the three PO models with a large recall drop, extending the captions adds few new object categories. Future PO training should therefore target grounded category coverage and keep the hallucination reduction that remains at matched recall. Preference pairs at similar recall and coverage-aware rewards that favor verified objects are two candidates to test by set-level F1 and hallucination at matched recall. Base-only candidates need verification, since only 38.5 to 41.8 percent of them are correct on the held-out set.
blocks.zh: 对于三个PO模型,大回放,扩展标题会增加很少新的对象类别. 因此,未来的参与组织培训应针对基于基础的类别覆盖面,并保持仍能相应召回的减少幻觉。 在类似的召回和覆盖意识的奖励中,偏好核实的对象是两个通过设定F1级测试和在相应召回时产生幻觉的候选人。 只有基数候选人需要核查,因为只有38.5%至41.8%的候选人在被搁置的情况下是正确的。

blocks.en:
Yue et al . [ 25 ] reduce hallucination by training the EOS decision, and in our study early stopping of the base model reproduces most of the CHAIRi gain of three PO models.
Fazli et al . [ 4 ] show that inference-time methods trade informativeness for lower hallucination scores, and GACD [ 19 ] reports a small recall loss as an advantage.
We measure the same trade-off for trained PO checkpoints with a counterfactual of the base model.
LeHaCE [ 20 ] controls length, and our results point to recall as the more direct control for object hallucination of LVLMs.
Inference-time methods act on object mentions with reward-guided decoding (MRGD [ 14 ] ), claim admission by image-dependent evidence (EGVCA [ 5 ] ), self-validation of object existence in sampled captions [ 13 ] or local image crops (VIGOR [ 9 ] ).
Restoration needs one more greedy pass of the base model and no separate visual check, and only 41 to 45 percent of the categories it appends on the held-out set are correct.
V-DPO [ 21 ] and C 2 -DPO [ 7 ] train PO models for visual or context grounding.
The recall-controlled evaluation can be applied to these methods, which we did not run.
blocks.zh:

Fazli等人[4] 表明推论时间方法以信息性换取较低的幻觉分数,GACD[19]报告一个小的召回损失作为优势.
我们对训练有素的PO检查站进行同样的权衡,与基地模式相反。
LeHACE [20] 控制长度,我们的结果指出,对LVLMs的物体幻觉的更直接的控制.
对物体的推论时间法以奖励制导的解码法(MRGD[14])提及,以图像依赖的证据承认索赔(EGVCA[5]),在抽样说明中自我验证物体的存在[13]或当地图像作物(VIGOR[9]).

V-DPO [21]和C 2-DPO [7] 列车PO模型用于视觉或上下文地面.
召回控制评价可以适用于这些方法,我们没有进行。

blocks.en:
We study one backbone, LLaVA-1.5-7B, with greedy decoding and one detailed-caption prompt, and our two COCO sets are disjoint but come from the same dataset.
Attribute and relation hallucination and the checkpoints we could not validate are outside this study.
The stopping curve belongs to the EOS-bias policy family, so recall matching controls only the part that EOS-only stopping reproduces, and caption length and object density still differ at equal recall ( Appendix C ).
The stopping share is a reproduction ratio, and we make no causal claim on the training effect.
All intervals are nominal 95 percent intervals without a correction for multiple comparisons.
Restoration covers only the object categories or noun lemmas that each benchmark recognizes.

属性和关系幻觉以及我们无法证实的检查站不在这项研究范围之内。
停止曲线属于EOS-bias政策家族,因此只记得匹配控制,只记得EOS停止复制的部分,标题长度和对象密度在等重回时仍然不同(附录C).

所有间隔都是名义上的95%的间隔,不做多次比较的更正.

blocks.en:
On yes/no questions a model that says less answers yes less often.
We add one constant to the yes versus no log-odds of the base model so that its yes ratio matches the yes ratio of the PO model.
The constant is chosen on half of the images and applied to the other half with the cross-fitting of the main text, and both models answer by forced choice between yes and no. Table G1 reports the accuracy difference and the share of questions with the same answer.

blocks.en:
Batched fp16 greedy decoding can flip near-tie tokens when the batch size changes, so every run uses one batch size from start to end, and a resumed run must have the same batch size, batch layout and input order.
On the development sets, the base model, RLAIF-V, CHAIR-DPO and CSR were decoded at batch size 32, and HA-DPO and the negative EOS runs at batch size 16. All held-out runs use batch size 16.
The development runs used A100 GPUs with 40 GB and 80 GB, and the held-out runs used one RTX PRO 6000 GPU. On 16 images, the batch size 16 captions of the two A100 types are identical. Table J1 compares the base model at the two batch sizes.
The captions are identical for 435 of 500 CHAIR images and 889 of 1,004 AMBER images, and every reported gain moves by at most 0.15 points.
With the base run at batch size 16, the development interval of CSR on CHAIR moves from [ − 0.03 -0.03 , 2.75] to [0.16, 2.82].
Applied to development captions of all models at batch size 16, with the PO captions taken from the λ = 0 \lambda=0 cut of the negative EOS runs, the frozen restoration thresholds of Appendix K keep the recall within 0.27 points of the base recall and give H u H_{\mathrm{u}} reductions of 5.19 [3.78, 6.82], 1.64 [0.64, 2.56], 1.07 [ − 0.07 -0.07 , 2.20] and 2.38 [0.68, 4.13] for RLAIF-V, CHAIR-DPO, CSR and HA-DPO.

For CHAIR the candidates are COCO categories found by the CHAIR extraction, and for AMBER they are noun lemmas of the AMBER hallucination vocabulary.
A candidate is a category of the base caption that the PO caption does not name.
Its score is the log-probability of the first token piece of its first mention, taken from the greedy pass of the base model.
Every candidate with a score strictly above τ \tau is appended as “There is also a {object} in the image.” in score order, and the restored caption is scored again as text.
On the development set, τ \tau is chosen by cross-fitting so that the restored captions reach the base recall, and a second threshold aims at the midpoint between the base and PO recalls.
For the held-out set we chose one threshold per model on the whole CHAIR development set and fixed it before generating the held-out images.
